name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 23 – Am 3
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 23. Calls for the revised Tobacco Products Directive to cover all tobacco and nicotine products and to include evidence-based and up-to-date regulatory measures with particular attention to health warnings and consumer information; underlines that such measures can include appropriate rules on packaging, restrictions on flavours that attract young consumers, mandatory reporting of ingredients, and a prohibition on the online sale of such products to minors, with effective age verification mechanisms, not least through the implementation of the EU Digital Identity Wallet;
